name: Rentzels Blueberry Farm
tagline: Link to Rentzel's Blueberry Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/Rentzels
description: Rentzels Blueberry Farm is a family-run farm in 137 Butter Rd, PA. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
